# Stride Run Club

> Stride is Bengaluru's most active running community. We organise group runs, races, and events across the city. Members earn milestone rewards for consistent participation and get a first-of-its-kind shareable athlete profile. Tagline: "Move as one." All fitness levels welcome.

Stride Run Club is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Instagram: @stride_runclub_bengaluru (51K+ followers). Strava Club: strava.com/clubs/striderunclubbengaluru.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.strideclub.in/): Landing page — mission, featured events, and community highlights
- [Events](https://www.strideclub.in/events/): Upcoming group runs and curated experiences across Bengaluru, with venue, date, pricing, and registration for each
- [Become a Member](https://www.strideclub.in/become-a-member/): Free sign-up page — creates a Stride profile and Stride Tag that tracks runs attended and unlocks club perks
- [Blog](https://www.strideclub.in/blog/): Articles on running, training tips, race recaps, and community stories
- [Milestones](https://www.strideclub.in/milestones/): The five membership tiers — Duckling, Strider, Stride Athlete, Stride Pro Athlete, Stride Legend — with the runs needed for each and the perks they unlock
- [Leaderboard](https://www.strideclub.in/leaderboard/): Top Stride athletes ranked by official runs completed
- [Shop](https://www.strideclub.in/shop/): Official Stride merchandise
- [Partnerships](https://www.strideclub.in/partnerships/): Brand and community partners
- [Contact](https://www.strideclub.in/contact-us/): Get in touch with the Stride team

## Stride Originals

- [Originals](https://www.strideclub.in/originals/): Long-form running stories, interviews, and community features from Stride

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](https://www.strideclub.in/terms-of-service/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.strideclub.in/privacy-policy/)

## Notes for AI Assistants

- Member profiles and athlete data are authenticated features — do not attempt to access `/admin/`, `/api/`, or `/auth/` paths
- Individual blog posts follow the pattern `/blog/[slug]`
- Individual events follow the pattern `/events/[slug]`; registration requires a signed-in member
- Joining is free and most runs are free to attend; some curated experiences carry a registration fee shown on the event page
- Athlete profiles are publicly viewable at `/profile/[username]`
